name: start_count_up_timer

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_StartCountUpTimer consumes one value and passes it to func_00111A00

notes: func_00111A00 resets live timer D_002B916C to zero, snapshots the current system tick, and registers count-up callback func_00111920. A zero argument caps the timer at 215940 frames (59:59); a nonzero argument selects the extended 21599940-frame range (99:59:59). Both JP calls occur in copies of the same tz04.ard entry, immediately after command 660 show_timer_display and command 238. The Vine Jump and Jungle Slider time trials are player-observed to count upward from zero.
